chosen_edition: The Hymnal of the Reformed Church (1920), no. 136

editorial.method: Human word-for-word comparison against the chosen edition required

notes: All five of Hopkins's stanzas plus the refrain (stanza 1 and refrain under the music, 2-5 printed below); syllable hyphens rejoined and the sung 'Amen' omitted. Stanza 5 reads 'Heaven and earth replies' and the line divisions follow the print, with 'Field and fountain, moor and mountain' as one line.
